headline: Marban Hollow Ablaze; Kuura Strand Quiets as Nevish Line Turns
war_summary: The front has shifted since the last edition. Kuura Strand, which erupted at our previous report, has gone quiet: eleven events in the past six hours but none in the last two, and Wardens now hold all six posts in that hex. Nevish Line, where Colonials held the edge earlier, now stands six Warden posts against two Colonial, with forty-seven events across the day and Grief Mother and Princefal the busiest works. Marban Hollow is the freshest fire, five events in two hours to the cutoff and one position unclaimed; the latest hour's losses run near 411 Colonial and 484 Warden. Callahan's Passage holds at eight Warden posts to two Colonial through twenty-nine events. Weathered Expanse stands two Warden against seven Colonial, Wardens having lost about eight thousand men there in a day. Palantine Berm, wholly Warden at seven posts, saw thirty-six events. Stlican Shelf is eight Colonial to one Warden; Stonecradle seven to two; Mooring County eleven Warden to one Colonial. No victor has been declared.
